units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. Low locked shot on black water at night. Angular crests travel slowly toward camera, each briefly catching the single amber glint and dropping back to black. No camera move. No people, no text, no daylight.

units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. Locked wide shot from behind the carver. His arm rises and strikes in a slow rhythm; chips fall from the rows of wedge cuts; the torch flares and settles so the raking light sweeps across them. Smoke curls. Very small push. No face on the stone, no text.
